questions.question: At Newlands Stadium, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Heat or Rhinos?
Western Province hold the record for most consecutive t20 titles won. What is their record?
questions.explanation: WP were the t20 champions every season from 2014/15 to 2017/18

questions.question: At which ground did Angelique Taai record their career-best innings (63*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Buffalo Park, against Kei on 2016/02/14.

questions.question: At which ground did Cobras record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Wanderers — highest total of 198, against Lions on 2024/11/17.

questions.question: At which ground did Cobras record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 109, against Badgers on 2024/12/15.
